content.title: 'The Pitt' Season 2 Finale Officially Gets a Rare Theatrical Release 3 Days Early - IMDb
content.text: 'The Pitt' Season 2 Finale Officially Gets a Rare Theatrical Release 3 Days EarlyThe Pitt Season 2 has been streaming on HBO Max for almost two months, and the show is finally set to conclude with three more episodes over the next three Thursdays. Although the entire season has taken place over only one shift at Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Center — a characteristic that has become a trademark for the show — a lot has certainly happened since our favorite doctors and nurses clocked in this morning. It’s been a rough day for everyone, especially Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle), who has been introduced to his replacement before he goes on his lengthy sabbatical.
